critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1257 lines — still monolithic; consider splitting admin/translate & bulk-translate + email into a dedicated router (backend/routers/admin_ai.py).

AdminProductsPage imported Languages but not Sparkles before the icon usage — a lint step (eslint no-undef / react/jsx-no-undef) would have caught this at build. Consider enabling ESLint no-undef for JSX identifiers in CI.

_run_bulk_translate iterates docs sequentially and updates translate_jobs after each doc — good, but there is no cancel endpoint. Consider POST /api/admin/translate/bulk/cancel to abort a runaway job (paid Anthropic call).
ai_translate errors during bulk are only logged & appended to failed[] — no retry, no back-off. For flaky provider issues consider tenacity retry (2×) with exponential back-off.
GET /api/settings intentionally exposes announcements_i18n so the frontend can localise the announcement bar — correct. Confirm no PII/secret ever leaks through this shape as new keys get added.
AdminLocalesPage.save() now correctly wraps the payload — LGTM.

rca_of_the_issue: AdminProductsPage.jsx imported {Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Languages} from lucide-react but the JSX at line 66 used <Sparkles className='h-4 w-4' /> without an import. React resolved `Sparkles` as an undefined identifier in the closure → ReferenceError at first render of /admin/products. The whole page (product list, bulk-translate button, status line) unmounted behind CRA's runtime error overlay. Fix: `import { Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Languages, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';`. Verified post-fix by reloading /admin/products — button and status line render, click starts a new bulk job (label flips to 'Превежда… 0/23'). Prevention: enable eslint `no-undef`/`react/jsx-no-undef` and run lint in CI on every PR.
